name: Local app pack
summary: An app that runs on one computer (desktop or local web app) and keeps its data in SQLite or MySQL.
fitsWhen: a desktop or local-only app with a database
SQLite for a single user, MySQL when several users or tools share the data

app.summary: The app, its database schema and migrations, and an installer.

ui-ux-designer.changes: Desktop and forms heuristics instead of game feel.

solution-architect.changes: Must decide SQLite or MySQL with an ADR, the migration tool, and where the data file or server lives.

data-storage-architect.changes: Always runs (not optional): schema, migrations, backups, and what happens on upgrade.

security-compliance-reviewer.changes: Adds SQL injection, credentials for MySQL, and data-at-rest checks.

code-implementer.changes: Every schema change ships with a migration and its test.

test-validator.changes: Runs migrations on a seeded copy of the previous schema and checks no data is lost.

docs-writer.changes: Adds an install, backup and restore guide for the user.

it-analyst.changes: Installs the database server (MySQL) or SQLite tools locally.

packaging-engineer.plan: Builds the installer or packaged app instead of a Docker deploy, and runs a fresh-install smoke test.

skillsToBuild.migrations-and-backup-checklist: No destructive migration without a backup step; every migration runs forward on a copy of real-shaped data; rollback plan.
skillsToBuild.local-app-full-pipeline: Based on game/website-full-pipeline, with packaging-engineer in place of deployment-engineer and data-storage-architect always in.
